### Sometimes God Doesn't Choose the "Perfect" Girl for the Job
Author: Glynnis Whitwer
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/sometimes-god-doesn-t-choose-the-perfect-girl-for-the-job-encouragement-for-today-june-25-2014.html
Passage: Joshua 2:1
Points:
- God does not reserve important kingdom assignments solely for people with flawless backgrounds.
- Rahab's grit and quick thinking made her uniquely suited to protect the spies in a crisis.
- Rather than judging her by her past reputation, God saw her receptive heart and potential.
- Believers should not disqualify themselves, but surrender their messy stories and traits to God.

### No Such Thing as Coincidence
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-august-11-2026.html
Passage: Joshua 2:1
Points:
- The arrival of the spies at Rahab's home was ordered by divine providence, not chance.
- God works simultaneously on both sides of divine appointments.
- The Lord softens a seeker's heart while preparing a messenger to reach them.
- Believers must look for God's orchestration in daily life and obey His prompting.
